name: Smart Voice Control LED Light for Laptop Night Light USB Artificial Intelligent Lamp
description:
Illuminate your space effortlessly with this voice-activated night light, designed for convenience, energy efficiency, and modern style. Perfect for bedrooms, study areas, and offices.

Key Features

Voice Control: Lights up or switches modes with normal voice commands within 2 meters (ambient noise ≤ 60dB).

Versatile Power Supply: Compatible with adapter, computer USB, rechargeable battery, or USB plug power sources.

Even Illumination: Equipped with 16 LED light beads in a double ring design for uniform light distribution.

Adjustable Brightness & Color: 3 shades of light with color temperature ranging from 3000K to 6000K.

Compact & Stylish: Made from durable ABS and hose material, height approx. 320mm, lamp head diameter approx. 83mm.

Energy Efficient: 1.5W power consumption with luminous flux of 90LM, providing soft yet bright light.
